title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten free, under-21-safe outings at Gonzaga and in Spokane parks, each supported by a university or city source confirming public, no-admission access.

cards.title: Browse Bing Crosby’s Boyhood Home
cards.subtitle: A free public museum on Gonzaga’s campus
cards.notes: Bring a friend to compare more than 200 records, trophies, awards, and other Crosby artifacts displayed on the main floor.
cards.short_summary: Explore Gonzaga’s collection of Bing Crosby memorabilia inside his childhood home.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga states that the Bing Crosby House Museum is free and open to the public and displays more than 200 Crosby items.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; consult the museum page for current operating hours and university-holiday closures.

cards.title: Walk the Japanese Garden Paths
cards.subtitle: A no-admission garden outing in Manito Park
cards.notes: Take a slow group walk through the gated garden, pausing to notice how its paths, water, plants, and stonework frame each view.
cards.short_summary: Share a quiet walk through Manito Park’s Japanese-style garden.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s 2025 Manito walking-tour brochure says every inch of Manito Park, including the Japanese Garden, is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: A Walking Tour of Manito Park – August 2025
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; the gated garden may follow seasonal hours, so check posted access information before visiting.

cards.title: Trace the Symmetry at Duncan Garden
cards.subtitle: Formal garden paths with no entry charge
cards.notes: Meet at the central path, walk the garden’s geometric layout together, and use the seasonal flower beds as photo backdrops.
cards.short_summary: Study the changing colors and formal geometry of a Renaissance-style garden.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s 2025 Manito walking-tour brochure identifies Duncan Garden within Manito Park and says every inch of the park is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: A Walking Tour of Manito Park – August 2025
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public every day of the year; ordinary park rules and any posted garden restrictions apply.

cards.title: Compare Plants in Gaiser Conservatory
cards.subtitle: A free greenhouse visit inside Manito Park
cards.notes: Walk room by room with a friend and choose one unfamiliar plant each to identify from the conservatory’s labels or displays.
cards.short_summary: Warm up among seasonal displays and tropical plants without buying a ticket.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s 2025 Manito walking-tour brochure includes Gaiser Conservatory and states that every inch of Manito Park is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: A Walking Tour of Manito Park – August 2025
cards.access_notes: No admission is required; enter only during the conservatory’s posted operating hours and observe posted plant-protection rules.

cards.title: Make a Perennial Color Survey
cards.subtitle: A free seasonal garden walk at Manito Park
cards.notes: Pick a color and walk the sloping beds together, photographing or listing each different perennial bloom you find in that shade.
cards.short_summary: Turn a garden stroll into a collaborative search for seasonal colors.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s Manito walking-tour brochure names the Joel E. Ferris Perennial Garden and says all of Manito Park is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: A Walking Tour of Manito Park – August 2025
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; remain on established paths and do not pick flowers or disturb plantings.

cards.title: Compare the Roses on Rose Hill
cards.subtitle: A no-ticket horticultural stop in Manito Park
cards.notes: Walk the beds with friends and compare bloom shape, color, and fragrance while leaving flowers and identification labels undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: Use the labeled rose collection as the focus of a relaxed outdoor meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s 2025 Manito walking-tour brochure includes Rose Hill and explicitly says every inch of Manito Park is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: A Walking Tour of Manito Park – August 2025
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; visit during park hours and keep to paths while viewing the seasonal plantings.

cards.title: Dig into Ice Age Floods
cards.subtitle: Free geology-themed play on Riverfront Park’s North Bank
cards.notes: Try the fossil dig, log-jam climber, and flood-themed features together, then connect each element to the region’s geology.
cards.short_summary: Mix active play with an outdoor introduction to Spokane’s Ice Age flood landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says the North Bank amenities are free for everyone and identifies the Ice Age Floods Playground among them.
cards.source_title: Riverfront Ice Age Floods Playground & North Bank Open May 21
cards.access_notes: Free for everyone; use during posted playground hours, with the splash pad operating on its own seasonal schedule.

cards.title: Run a Wheels Session
cards.subtitle: A free public skate park at Riverfront Park
cards.notes: Bring your own suitable wheels and helmet, agree on a line before starting, and take turns while respecting other park users.
cards.short_summary: Practice skate-park lines together on the North Bank’s bowls and street features.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Skate and Wheels Park as a North Bank amenity and states that the redeveloped area is free for everyone to use.
cards.source_title: Riverfront Ice Age Floods Playground & North Bank Open May 21
cards.access_notes: No admission or purchase is required; bring your own equipment and follow posted safety rules and park hours.

cards.title: Start a Half-Court Shootaround
cards.subtitle: Free outdoor basketball space on the North Bank
cards.notes: Bring a basketball, divide the court fairly with other users, and rotate through shooting games or a casual half-court session.
cards.short_summary: Gather for an informal basketball session on colorful public courts.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies Hooptown USA Courts among the North Bank amenities and says the area is free for everyone in the community to use.
cards.source_title: Riverfront Ice Age Floods Playground & North Bank Open May 21
cards.access_notes: Free public use requires no reservation when courts are available; bring your own ball and yield to scheduled activities.

cards.title: Try the Roskelley Boulder
cards.subtitle: Free outdoor bouldering at Riverfront Park
cards.notes: Warm up first, choose moves within your ability, keep the landing clear, and spot one another without climbing beneath others.
cards.short_summary: Work through outdoor bouldering moves with friends on a purpose-built public feature.
cards.evidence_claim: The City names the Roskelley Performance Climbing Boulder as a North Bank amenity and states that the area is free for everyone to use.
cards.source_title: Riverfront Ice Age Floods Playground & North Bank Open May 21
cards.access_notes: Free public use requires no admission; climb at your own risk and obey posted rules, closures, and park hours.
